constellations.summary: The backbone of Hydro reaction teams providing continuous Rain Swords, damage reduction, and micro-healing.
Extends Burst duration by 3s and decreases Hydro RES of attacked enemies by 15%.
Every third Rain Sword attack launches 5 swords and regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu.

weapons.name: Sacrificial Sword
weapons.reasoning: 80% chance to reset high cooldown Skill, providing two huge batches of energy particles.

weapons.name: Favonius Sword
weapons.reasoning: Generates clear energy particles for the entire team.

weapons.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
weapons.reasoning: Highest offensive DPS sword once Energy Recharge requirements are satisfied.

artifactSets.reasoning: +20% ER and converts ER directly into Rain Sword Burst DMG.

teamComps.name: National Core
teamComps.rotation: Xingqiu E Q E -> Bennett Q E -> Xiangling Q E -> Sucrose E Normal Attacks

notes: Sacrificial Sword is his true BiS weapon at R3+.
